note: Bermuda: a non-Bermudian musician or entertainer needs a work permit from the Department of Immigration, granted only once they hold active membership of the Bermuda Entertainment Union by paying travellers' dues (the Minister of Home Affairs, 15 September 2017). No days without it. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: Parliament of Bermuda, Ministerial Statement by the Minister of Home Affairs, The Next Wave of Changes to Immigration Policies and Procedures (15 September 2017)
sources.said: all non-Bermudian musicians/entertainers will be ... required to maintain an active membership with the BEU by paying travelers’ dues ... to the BEU before work permits will be granted.
